title: Makeup / Dab Jar Display With Shelves
author: Splitbarrel2
description:
This is the first project I made after downloading fusion 360 its just a simple display for small jars like make up jars or dab jars. It has 4 tiers and each tier has 4 cut out circles for the jars to sit. If you have any recommendation to change or add anything please let me know!

Check out the rest of my stoner gear here: https://makerworld.com/collections/10444921
